statement: Suppose g = 0, p = N, and T(N, N) = −H < 0 on a smooth boundary portion, where N is inward. Let Greek indices be tangent to this boundary and put hαβ = ⟨∇αN, eβ⟩. Then TNα = 0, Tαβ = hαβ, and H = tr h; in particular H is a sum of principal curvatures with the specified convention, without division by m − 1. If ∇∂ is the boundary connection, all components of B are described, up to permutation of slots, by Bαβγ = (∇∂ αh)βγ, BNNα = −∂αH, (3.10) BNαβ = TNN Tαβ − (T2 )αβ, BNNN = w2 . (3.11) The components with an odd number of normal slots are thus determined by the pointwise tensor T; the other components involve tangential derivatives of curvature. The tensor V below encodes this odd-normal part after normalization. Here w > 0. Define the normalized tensors and eigenvalue A = T/w, λ = TNN /w = −H/w, S0 = λA − A2 , and the symmetric tensor Vijk = pi(S0)jk + pj(S0)ki + pk(S0)ij + pipjpk. (3.12) Then |p| = 1, Ap = λp, λ < 0, S0p = 0, tr S0 = −1, and V is trace-free. The tensors B/w2 and V agree in every component with an odd number of normal slots.
